id: # Transportation design: a car from side-view sketch to render, colourways and views, a city car in 3D, a bus concept, a cabin in 360° and driving footage. Every run becomes an example for students of this speciality, beside the card's showcase (tools/maintenance/seed_examples.cjs --speciality transportation).

caption: A side-view sketch of an electric sports coupe, ballpoint and marker on grey paper, made from words as a stand-in for a scanned sketch. The render, the colourway, the rear view and the driving clip all come from it.
prompt: Automotive design sketch on light grey paper: the side view of a low, sleek two-seat electric sports coupe drawn with a confident black ballpoint line, a long wheelbase, very short overhangs, a fastback roofline flowing into a cut-off tail and oversized wheels, the body shaded with grey marker and white pencil highlights along the shoulder line, a dark ground shadow under the car. One car, centred, nothing else on the page, evenly lit flat scan.

caption: The sketch rendered as a studio photograph that keeps its line: lay the two side by side and the roofline, the shoulder, the wheel arches and the tail match. Liquid silver paint, tinted glass, aero wheels, a red light bar.
prompt: Studio photograph of a low sleek two-seat electric sports coupe in side view, following the drawing exactly: liquid metallic silver paint, a tinted glass canopy, black multi-spoke aero wheels, a thin red light bar across the tail, on a polished dark studio floor with a soft reflection, one large softbox above, a dark grey background.

caption: A colourway and a setting in one request: matte olive paint, bronze wheels, a salt flat at golden hour. The body, every line and the side view are unchanged from the studio render, which is what makes colourways comparable.
prompt: Repaint the car in <Picture 1> in a matte deep olive green with bronze wheels and place it on a sunlit desert salt flat at golden hour, with long shadows and a pale sky. Keep the car's shape, every line of its body and the side view exactly the same.

caption: The coupe from behind and above, invented from the single side view: the tail light bar, the glass roof and the rear wheels follow the render. It came out closer to a top view than the 3/4 asked for; keep the seed and move the camera to try other angles.

A city bus concept as a cinematic film still: the wraparound glazing, the light strip around the body, passengers in warm light on a wet night street, and the destination 'LINE 7 — PORT' spelled right. A mood image for a presentation board.
prompt: Cinematic film still, a futuristic electric city bus concept at night in the rain, low three-quarter front view from the kerb: a long single-deck bus with a fully glazed front that wraps up into the roof, a continuous thin white light strip around the body, a destination display reading 'LINE 7 — PORT' in amber, passengers silhouetted inside under warm light, wet asphalt reflecting the neon of the city, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flare.

caption: A compact city car concept photographed on white: a pebble-shaped body, a large windscreen, mint paint with a white roof. Made to be turned into 3D in the next example.
prompt: Product photograph of a compact electric city car concept on a plain white background, three-quarter front view: a short, tall, rounded body shaped like a pebble, a huge single windscreen, sliding doors, pastel mint paint with a white roof, small round headlights and black aero wheel covers. Centred, soft studio light, a soft shadow under the car.

caption: The city car photo turned into a textured 3D model (GLB, about 490,000 vertices, with colour, roughness and normal maps). Spin it: four wheels, the doors and windows, even seats inside, all from one front 3/4 photo.

Press View in 360° inside a driverless minibus: grey seats, a glass roof, side windows onto a tree-lined street. It made several rows of seats rather than the four facing seats around a table asked for: a quick feel for a cabin, not its layout.
place_2: inside the cabin of a driverless electric minibus: a small lounge with four facing seats in pale grey wool around a round table, no steering wheel and no driver's seat, a panoramic glass roof, large side windows onto a tree-lined city street, a light wood floor and soft ambient strip lighting along the ceiling

caption: The olive coupe set in motion on the salt flat: it pulls away, turns and drives off towards the mountains with a trail of dust. The camera stays put rather than tracking alongside as asked, and the motor sound is faint.
prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The car pulls away slowly across the salt flat, its wheels turning, a fine trail of white dust rising behind it, the camera tracking alongside at the same speed so the car stays in frame while the distant mountains slide past. Golden-hour light glints along the bodywork. The quiet whine of an electric motor and the crunch of salt under the tyres. No text, no black frames.

caption: A driving film in 2K (1920×1088), from words only: a low tracking shot beside a silver coupe on a coastal road that rises into an aerial view of the bends and the sea, with the sound of the road and the wind. Watch it full screen.
prompt: A low tracking shot alongside a sleek silver electric sports coupe driving along a winding coastal road at sunset, the sea glittering far below the cliffs, the camera keeping pace beside the front wheel, then rising slowly to reveal the whole car and the road ahead. We hear the soft electric whine of the motor, the tyres on the asphalt and the wind.
